Post-processing chain tuning for the star-field engine —
Sourcesrc/core\tokens\starfield\params\post.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

BLOOM_THRESHOLD

Bloom luminance gate — only texels above this threshold bleed into the bloom pyramid. 0.55 keeps nebula glows and star cores blooming while the mid-tone planet textures and the skybox stay sharp.

BLOOM_STRENGTH

Bloom contribution added on top of the scene color.

BLOOM_RADIUS

Bloom blur radius — wider reads dreamier, tighter reads optical.

VIGNETTE_DARKNESS

Vignette edge darkness + reach — a whisper of lens falloff so the frame edges recede like a real eyepiece/sensor, never a black oval.

GRAIN_INTENSITY

Film-grain intensity — just enough noise to kill the banding that additive glow gradients leave on dark space backgrounds.
